access.decision: Gary Oct 29 2026 2:52 AM CT (pt1814u): Frostspire gets NO train station; it is reached by the Skylift only.

daily_bonus._note: Paid once per in-game day (clock.day) by RT Payroll, amount = Benefits node daily_bonus rank value. Never paid during a battle, talk or cutscene (waits for a free moment).

promotions.title: Senior Field Associate
promotions.quest_desc: Cold-site audit: beat 3 climbers on Frostspire Pass, then report to the RT supervisor in Frostspire.

promotions.title: Field Lead
promotions.quest_desc: Field lead review: beat the Frostspire Master and help the cold climber, then report to the RT supervisor.

r4_daily_bonus: {employee_id}: daily bonus, {amount} gold. Don't spend it all on snacks.
r4_daily_bonus_2: Payroll ran. {amount} gold to {employee_id}. You're welcome.
r4_daily_bonus_3: {amount} gold deposited. Company morale target: met. Barely.
r4_daily_bonus_4: New day, {employee_id}. {amount} gold. Try to earn it this time.
r4_promotion_hold: {employee_id}: your ID can't go up until you're reviewed.
Your XP is on hold. See the supervisor in Frostspire.
r4_promotion_hold_2: Promotion review pending, {employee_id}. XP is frozen. Like everything up here.
r4_promotion_hold_3: You hit the ceiling, {employee_id}. Go impress someone in Frostspire.
r4_promotion_hold_4: XP paused. HR says it builds character. HR is me.
r4_promotion_2: {title}. Congratulations, {employee_id}. The paperwork was the hard part.
r4_promotion_3: New title on file: {title}. Asset value per employee: up.
r4_promotion_4: {employee_id}, {title}. Don't let it go to your head. It's cold up there.
r4_skylift: Frostspire. No trains. One cable. Rated for one, {employee_id}.
r4_skylift_2: Hold the rail, {employee_id}. Replacing you costs paperwork.
r4_skylift_3: Altitude logged. Your hands look cold. Not my department.
r4_skylift_4: Cable lift ride, {employee_id}. Company pays. This time.
master_beaten_frostspire: Master of Frostspire beaten. {employee_id}, that's four coins.
The build stops here for now. Asset value, however, never stops.
master_beaten_frostspire_2: Four coins, {employee_id}. The wind up there lost. To you.
master_beaten_frostspire_3: Frostspire coin acquired. Your ID file is getting heavy.
master_beaten_frostspire_4: Coin four. I'd clap, but I'm software.

closed: Lift's shut. Bridge first, then we talk.
open: Skylift's the only way up. Rated for one.
Hold the rail. Don't look down. Okay, look a bit.

night: Night run. Cable hums louder in the cold.

start: Hands are too cold to tie a knot.
waiting: Still cold. Fern Mint Tea, from The Firefly.
give: Fern mint. That's the stuff. Fingers are back.
Take this Large Salve. Mountains eat small ones.
after: Knots are holding. Thanks to you.

idle: RT Frostspire office. Cold coffee, warm paperwork.
hold: Your review's ready, {employee_id}. Finish the task first:
ceremony: By order of Revival Tech, you are now {title}.
Clap, everyone. That means you, Hale.
after: Back to work. Promotions don't pay for themselves.

default: Bet my sled is faster than the Skylift!
after_master: You beat Hale? Can you teach me the wind thing?

default: Snow's early. Rimewicks come to the windows when it's this cold.
night: Shh. Aurorels come out at night. Look up.
after_master: Hale's in a good mood. First time in years someone made it fair.
tea_offer: Cold out. Cup of pine tea?
tea_yes: Here. Hold it with both hands. There, colour in your cheeks again.
tea_no: Pot stays warm. Come back any time.

frostspire_sign_skylift: SKYLIFT. Frostspire to the pass. One rider at a time.
frostspire_sign_benefits: RT FROSTSPIRE OFFICE. Promotions, reviews, payroll.
